ratings_methodology.general_formula: weighted arithmetic mean of the five skills using role-specific weights

sources.use: 2026/27 early team-level results, not used to infer individual skill reliably

ratings_methodology.important_limits: Not a full individual statistical regression. 2026/27 season sample too small. Individual curated anchors based on known reputation and 2025/26 results; remaining players are deterministic role-based estimates. Do not present numeric values as officially measured. Receiving for non-receivers and attacking for liberos are gameplay competence, not measured performance.
ratings_methodology.lineup_caveat: projected_starting_7 is unverified and affects prior only, not verified status

additional_evidence.notes: Only named player skill ratings adjusted from explicit season leaderboards; other estimates remain prior editorial ratings. No comprehensive 167-player statistical re-estimation. National team participation alone is not an automatic rating bonus.

appearance_notes: Visual video-game customization only, not ethnicity. Null means unknown, not default. Avoid predicting skin tone or hair from name/nationality. Hair color not applicable for bald players can remain null. User-requested binary skin palette is restrictive and may not represent real people accurately; consider additional shades later.

verification_report.note: Only direct 2026/27 official jersey-number sources used. Official photo galleries identified for Milano, Monza and Lube; no individual photo classifications asserted without visual review. All unknown appearances remain null.
verification_report.roster_discrepancy: Lube official 2026/27 website also lists Miran Kujundzic #10, absent from initial 167-player roster; needs roster membership confirmation before addition.

uniform_colors_note: Kit generici per il videogioco: home/away/libero. 2026/27 verificato solo quando specificato; le altre palette sono indicative. Colori HEX scelti per gameplay e non estratti dalle maglie.

verification_summary.note: Official club rosters as of Oct 23; visual features are not inferred from nationality or names. Old players removed from active roster retained in removed_from_active_roster.
